## Plea Bargains
For sentences of at least 15 minutes, but not those classified as Capital Crimes, prisoners may request a Lawyer to obtain a plea bargain. In these cases, Internal Affairs Agents will represent Security. In this situation, Internal Affairs Agents are expected to obtain Security's records of the crime, and are to negotiate on behalf of Security. Upon reaching a conclusion, this deal should be presented to the Warden, but the Warden is not obligated to accept it. A second bargain may be attempted if the first is rejected, but after a second rejection, the prisoner must wait out their sentence.
In the absence of Internal Affairs Agents, the Warden is within their right to deny this request outright.
